info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Financial Statement Updates API
info.description: The Financial Statement Updates API allows financial institutions to modify existing financial statement records in their systems. By leveraging this API, users can update specific details related to financial statements such as balance sheets or income statements quickly and efficiently. This functionality is particularly useful for accountants and auditors who require accurate and up-to-date data for reporting and compliance. The API supports streamlined operations that ensure your financial records are always current and reflect the latest changes in financial standings.

patch.description: This endpoint allows users to modify the details of a specific financial statement identified by RES-100045. It supports partial updates to the financial statement information.

requestBody.description: The request body for updating the financial statement with the specified ID. This includes any fields that need to be modified or updated.
